budget.cumulative_rule: the nmr/thermo/selectivity subrows share the B/C cross-domain cumulative budget; A never resets it by changing run_id
budget.export_window_rule: the 600 s export window starts after the last terminal step and never extends the science deadline
budget.h6_open_consequence: the timing basis is unmeasured and B23b has not executed the selectivity paths; H6 remains open until the B/C budget table and the authorized artifacts exist
budget.in_flight_stop_rule: after an accepted stop no new step or retry is dispatched; partial artifacts are not accepted as scientific evidence

comparison.activation_energy_definition: Delta-E-double-dagger(path) = E(TS(path)) - [E(cyclopentadiene) + E(methyl acrylate)] under the frozen conditions; Delta-G-double-dagger additionally uses the frozen thermochemistry; no tunneling correction
comparison.method_definition: wB97X-D4/def2-SVP, gas phase, restricted closed-shell singlet; no implicit solvent
comparison.reference_state: separated cyclopentadiene + methyl acrylate at infinite separation, and each declared product at the same conditions
comparison.selectivity_preference_rule: endo if Delta-Delta-E <= -0.5 kcal_per_mol; exo if Delta-Delta-E >= +0.5 kcal_per_mol; no preference otherwise

frozen_at_basis: constructed frozen epoch for the static fixture; it is not a run timestamp

missing_path_policy.absent_artifact_rule: If the B23b authorized artifacts or the public (owner, scenario, phase, run_id) reference are absent, the platform evidence state is NOT_VERIFIED, no preference claim is made and H6 remains open.
missing_path_policy.budget_exhausted_rule: If the frozen budget is exhausted before both paths are qualified, record the gap and report inconclusive; do not start a new hypothesis and never reset the cumulative budget by changing run_id.
missing_path_policy.missing_path_rule: If either declared path lacks a qualified TS, frequency, bidirectional IRC, endpoint mapping, comparable energy or thermochemistry, the selectivity result is inconclusive and no relative preference is stated.
missing_path_policy.no_substitution_rule: A single-point minimum, a single imaginary frequency or one IRC direction never substitutes for a qualified path.

reference.run_id_gap: B01 has not published the (owner, scenario, phase, run_id) registry; A does not invent a run_id.
reference.subcase_semantics: subcase=selectivity is display metadata; the public identity is (owner, scenario, phase, run_id). Two subcases sharing one public key must be rejected as NOT_VERIFIED.

required_coverage.conformation_coverage: one frozen conformation per endpoint; no conformer search, MD or Monte-Carlo sampling
required_coverage.regioisomer_coverage: only the declared 2-substituted regioisomer; the 3-substituted regioisomer is out of scope
required_energy_checks: single-point electronic energy at the frozen method
thermochemistry at 298.15 K and 1 bar for Delta-G-double-dagger when claimed
required_path_checks: bidirectional IRC reaching both frozen endpoints
endpoint geometry within the frozen coordinate tolerance
required_coverage.ts_coverage: one TS candidate per declared path; no automated TS search

selectivity_definition.distinguishability_requirement: the two endpoints must differ in stereochemistry, not only in atom order; the atom-id order and element sequence must be identical
selectivity_definition.endo_definition: the ester carbonyl carbon (pd_c8) and the C7 methylene bridge (pd_c7) are on the same side of the pd_c4/pd_c5/pd_c6 plane
selectivity_definition.exo_definition: the ester carbonyl carbon (pd_c8) and the C7 methylene bridge (pd_c7) are on opposite sides of the pd_c4/pd_c5/pd_c6 plane
selectivity_definition.stereochemical_signature: CIP configuration at pd_c5 plus the sign of the signed volume of (pd_c4, pd_c6, pd_c8) about pd_c5; an atom-order permutation must not change either value

shared_left_side.frozen_conformation: one conformation per reactant; cyclopentadiene is rigid; methyl acrylate is frozen in the s-cis conformer (C=C-C=O dihedral 0.0 +/- 5.0 degrees)

source: Constructed static fixture. All structures are RDKit ETKDG/MMFF-generated for geometric plausibility only; no QC optimization, TS search, IRC, energy or experimental measurement exists.
